No. 1948/41 – THURSDAY, JANUARY 07, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No. : GCF/ATH/KD/23/LR.

Land Min’s Ref No.: 13/97/LRB/360. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to develop water retaining area in upper part of the Parliament Lake under Greater Colombo Flood Control and Environment Promotion Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Ninety three (93) allotments of land in total extent of about 9.4387 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 to 93 in the Plan No. Co. 9567 dated 02.12.2015 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Pelawatta in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 479 F of Aruppitiya in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kaduwela in Colombo District of Western Province and described as follows.
